notes: Voxel Musou is a no-build, backend-free Three.js game (plain ES modules + vendored three r186), so the 'production build' is a copy of index.html, src/ and vendor/ into .ui-capture/out (script: .ui-capture/build.sh; node 22.23.5 pinned in mise.toml, used only for the seed generator). There are no API keys, network services or accounts; the only persistent data is the browser save in localStorage ('voxel-musou.save' = per stage x officer x difficulty best rank / fastest clear / most KOs, and 'voxel-musou.diff' = last picked difficulty). Data: .ui-capture/gen-save.mjs replays 81 wins of a months-long play history (chapters in order, trials sprinkled in, harder tiers later, skill improving over time, some later grinding for S) through the game's own record() from src/core/progress.js and the chapters' own rank formula/thresholds, producing 37 record cells across all 4 story chapters and all 3 trials, all 7 officers and all 4 difficulties (8 S, 22 A, 6 B, 1 C; e.g. Liu Bei barely scraped a C on Hard at Hulao Gate, Zhao Yun has S on Changban up to Chaos and a 1:31 Thousand Slain). Rebuild with `.ui-capture/build.sh`; `.ui-capture/verify.mjs` serves out/ and checks the whole module import graph resolves; `.ui-capture/serve.mjs` is a tiny static server with index.html fallback for local testing. That save is written to out/seed-save.js, which out/index.html loads (classic script, before src/main.js) and which installs it into localStorage only when the browser has no save yet; difficulty is preset to Hard. Effects for the user: every chapter is cleared, Lu Bu is unlocked, Hold the Bridge and The Gauntlet trials are unlocked, and Chaos difficulty is open. Main areas: title screen (Story 劇情模式 -> chapter cards with best ranks -> difficulty -> officer select with rank chips), Trials 演武試煉 (Thousand Slain / Hold the Bridge / The Gauntlet / Free battle), Records 戰績 wall, and the battle itself with HUD, minimap, objectives, pause menu and result screen. Requires WebGL2; sound starts on first input. Menus are keyboard/mouse/gamepad driven (arrows/WASD + Enter, Esc to go back).
